messages:
zara: quick heads-up: toggled `segment_cache_prefix` in staging (scope=segment) and saw ~0.2% of preview traffic route to spot pool. unexpected.

mike: saw the small spike on the routing heatmap at 08:44. paste the flag payload?

zara: minimal: {name: segment_cache_prefix, scope: segment, cache: prefix_kv, rollout: {pct: 10}}

ada: likely ordering quirk: cache transform runs before route-tier eval for non-tenant scopes. mutated keys matched cheap rules. opened OPS-3301.

ops-bot: [08:46] Autoscaler: no latency-pool scaling events.

zara: telemetry pain: rollout events only have final route + flag id. can't repro decision path. propose a compact eval trace in telemetry plus hashed_segment id for privacy.

mike: agree. suggestion: add enum-coded trace steps (e.g. X1=seg-resolve, X2=cache-prefix, X3=tier-eval) and a `telemetry_level` flag field (off|basic|trace). default basic.

ada: console preview should call a dryrun API that accepts a pseudo-request (tenant_hash, route_key, seq_len, segment_salt) and returns {decision, trace:["X2","X3"], est_route_delta}. console can show estimated diversion and warnings.

zara: privacy: dryrun telemetry must only include flag id + sample_hash. no raw tenant ids.

mike: ops safety: add a rollout gate: if dryrun predicts >0.1% of rollout exposure to non-latency pools for flags tagged `latency_sensitive=true`, block bump and require approver override in console.

ada: plan: 1) proto enum + telemetry_level (mike). 2) dryrun routing-sim (ada). 3) console preview wiring + blocking UI (zara). 4) short-term: revert flag in staging.

console-bot: [08:55] Dryrun job queued: /v1/config/dryrun id dq-6170.

ops-bot: [08:57] Flag revert: `segment_cache_prefix` rollout.pct=0 by zara.

mike: one open debate: enums vs full strings on-wire. enums are smaller; console maps codes to text.

ada: +1. also add `docs/config-eval/orderings.md` with canonical ordering and quick examples for flag authors.

zara: logging thread to rollout-retro. thanks all. :thumbsup:
